questions: first_sound
the very first sound in the video after any silent title card
speech_starts
the moment the performer starts speaking or reciting bols out loud
speech_ends

late_fast_passage

the exact moment the drums and dhol groove first plays continuously, ending the spoken sample

late_dhol_break
a percussion-led break in the SECOND HALF of the track where singing stops and the drums take over
final_chorus
the last statement of the chorus hook before the track ends

the first statement of the opening melody
new_melody_second

third_section

opening_melody_returns
the moment the opening melody comes back
final_phrase
